```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(gt)
tuesdata <- tidytuesdayR::tt_load('2021-01-26')
tuesdata <- tidytuesdayR::tt_load(2021, week = 5)

plastics <- tuesdata$plastics
```

## Summary 1 - How Many Countries Each Brand Appears in

### Unmodified Column with custom function

```{r}
brand_country_count <- function(brand) {
  plastics |>
    filter(parent_company == brand,
           grand_total > 0) |>
    summarize(parent_company = brand,
      n_countries    = n_distinct(country),
      total_plastic  = sum(grand_total, na.rm = TRUE))
}

# top 20 brands by total plastic
top_brands <- plastics |>
  filter(!parent_company %in% c("Grand Total", "Unbranded")) |>
  group_by(parent_company) |>
  summarize(total = sum(grand_total, na.rm = TRUE)) |>
  slice_max(total, n = 20) |>
  pull(parent_company)

map(top_brands, brand_country_count) |>
  bind_rows() |>
  arrange(desc(n_countries)) |>
  gt::gt()
```

# Summary 2 - Plastic Type by Region

### Unmodified column with Iteration

```{r}
library(countrycode)

plastics_region <- plastics |>
  filter(parent_company == "Grand Total") |>
  mutate(region = countrycode(country, origin = "country.name", destination = "continent")) |>
  filter(!is.na(region)) |>
  pivot_longer(cols = hdpe:pvc, names_to  = "plastic_type", values_to = "count")

type_by_region <- function(ptype) {
  plastics_region |>
    filter(plastic_type == ptype) |>
    group_by(region) |>
    summarize(plastic_type = ptype, total = sum(count, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
    mutate(prop = total / sum(total))
}

plastic_types <- c("hdpe", "ldpe", "pet", "pp", "ps", "pvc", "o")
all_types <- map(plastic_types, type_by_region) |>
  bind_rows()

# For each region, find the dominant plastic type
dominant_type <- all_types |>
  group_by(region) |>
  slice_max(total, n = 1) |>
  select(region, dominant_type = plastic_type, dominant_total = total)

all_types |>
  arrange(plastic_type, desc(total)) |>
  left_join(dominant_type, by = "region") |>
  gt::gt()
```
